payload.reason: The evidence provides clear methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation through section title embeddings and classified section title embeddings.

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embeddings (STE) or classified section title embeddings (classified STE), which are integrated into the sentence representations.
The STE is generated by summing the last hidden states of tokenized section titles, while classified STE replaces intraclass STEs with a class embedding when applicable.
The hierarchical structure information, including section titles, is injected into the TLM sentence representations to enhance summarization tasks.
